| Part | Purpose |
|------|---------|
| `admin'` | Closes the string quote prematurely |
| `AND '1'='1'` | Always-true condition (bypasses auth) |
| `;` | Terminates the first query |
| `DROP TABLE users CASCADE;` | **Destroys the entire users table!** |
| `--` | Comments out remaining SQL |
